description_en: Modifies the enhanced monitoring metrics displayed for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS PostgreSQL实例展示的增强监控指标
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-metrics --db-instance-name pgm-bp1s1j103lo60000 --scope instance --metrics-config os.cpu_usage.sys.avg,os.cpu_usage.user.avg --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceMetrics

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the modification. Valid values:
instance: instance level. The modification applies only to cloud disk instance.
region: region level. The modification applies to all ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances that use the same storage type as cloud disk instance in the current region. For example, if cloud disk instance uses cloud disks, the modification applies to all ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances that use cloud disks in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
本次变更的应用范围。取值：
instance：实例级别，即仅将变更应用到当前实例。
region：地域级别，即将变更应用到当前地域中所有存储类型和当前实例相同的RDS PostgreSQL实例。例如当前实例为云盘，则本次变更会应用到当前地域下的所有RDS PostgreSQL云盘实例中
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring metrics of the instance. You can specify multiple metric keys and separate them with commas (,). A maximum of 30 metric keys can be specified.

You can call the DescribeAvailableMetrics operation to query the keys of enhanced monitoring metrics
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的监控指标。可传入多个指标Key，用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多30个。

您可调用DescribeAvailableMetrics接口获取增强监控指标Key
parameters.name: metrics_config

Scope.description_en:
The scope of the modification. Valid values:
instance: instance level.
region: region level
Scope.description_zh:
本次变更的应用范围。返回值：
instance：实例级别。
region：地域级别
